_classes.name: grant_only kind adjustment flips a 'The office shall' duty to power when the quote starts after 'shall'
_classes.rule: kind_adjusted=='grant_only' and kind_model=='duty' and kind=='power' (stricter variant without may/authoriz/empower/permit in quote: 40)

_classes.name: list item under a conditional power lead-in ('The powers granted by this subdivision may be exercised only if') forced to duty by rescued_imperative_item
model names a specific agency but agency resolves to the 'State agencies' group
_classes.rule: agency=='State agencies' and actor_resolved_model not generic (not matching state agenc|unspecified|state of new york|the state)

_classes.name: second distinct duty in one sentence (develop criteria vs regularly review/revise, different recurrence) dropped as duplicate_provision
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='duplicate_provision' whose first 150 chars of quote equal the kept record's quote named in reason 'overlaps <id>' (of 263 duplicate_provision drops)

_classes.name: sunset extension of an earlier chapter with no record: dropped extension_holder_unnamed, or silent (no stored and no dropped record)
_classes.rule: (a) dropped rule=='extension_holder_unnamed' [14 records]; (b) packet LAW TEXT matches (deemed repealed|expire|remain in full force and effect)[^.]{0,200}\[..\d{4}\] \{\{..\d{4}\}\} and law has no stored and no dropped record [laws, not records]; db_matches counts laws for (b); (a) adds 14 dropped records, e.g. 2009-A10118-01

_classes.name: record-level effective_date ignores a section-scoped effective date for the subparagraph the record quotes
_classes.rule: upper bound: record effective_date == law effective_date while the law's effective_dates entry has non-empty section_dates; deciding which records sit in the scoped section needs judgment
